assets.organize@1.description: Add a picture to your library, or pick one already there, and describe it so you can find it again.
assets.organize@1.expectedOutcome: A picture in your library, described and tagged so you can find it again.

steps.title: Upload a picture or choose one
steps.help: Your original is kept exactly as you uploaded it.

steps.title: Describe it
steps.help: Say what is in the picture, for people who cannot see it and for search.

steps.title: Tag it
steps.help: Pick from your tags so it turns up when you look for it later.

steps.title: Note where you used it
steps.help: Keep track of where it has already appeared.

nextSuggestions.why: Make more pictures in the same style.

brand.voice@1.description: Answer a few questions and share some of your writing, and get a guide to how you sound.
brand.voice@1.expectedOutcome: A brand guide that sounds like you, switched on so new writing uses it.

steps.title: Tell us how you sound
steps.help: A few questions about what you make and who it is for. You can stop and come back at any point.

steps.title: Add writing you're proud of
steps.help: A few pieces you wrote help the guide sound like you. Your originals are never changed.

steps.title: Read your guide and change anything
steps.help: It is your guide. Change any word that does not sound like you.

steps.title: Try it on a real piece
steps.help: See a short piece written with your guide before you decide.

steps.title: Switch it on
steps.help: From now on, new writing follows this guide. The workspace Owner makes this choice, and can switch back.

nextSuggestions.why: Write your first piece in your own voice.
Write posts that sound like you.

content.blog-and-seo@1.goal: Write a blog post or newsletter
content.blog-and-seo@1.description: Plan a full article or newsletter issue, write it section by section, and accept it when it reads right.
content.blog-and-seo@1.expectedOutcome: A finished article or newsletter you have accepted, with search suggestions and a copy to download.

steps.title: Choose what it's about
steps.help: Start from one of your recipes or from an idea of your own.

steps.title: Agree the plan
steps.help: Read the outline and change anything before any of it is written.

steps.title: Write it
steps.help: Write each section yourself or ask for a first go, then edit it however you like.

steps.title: Read it and accept it
steps.help: Read the whole piece. Accepting keeps this exact text as the finished one.

steps.title: Get search suggestions
steps.help: Suggested titles and descriptions to help people find it. They are suggestions only, never promises about ranking.

steps.title: Download it
steps.help: Take a copy to paste into your blog or newsletter tool.

nextSuggestions.why: Make pictures to go with it.
Tell your followers it is out.

images.create@1.description: Plan a picture of your food, make a few, and keep the ones you like in your library.
images.create@1.expectedOutcome: Pictures you chose, kept in your library, and the best one on your recipe if you like.

steps.title: Choose what the picture is for
steps.help: A recipe or an idea. Your brand's look is used unless you change it.

steps.title: Plan the picture
steps.help: Describe the scene, or start from a suggestion. You can change every word before anything is made.

steps.title: Make pictures and keep the best
steps.help: You see what it will use up before anything is made. Keep the ones you like; the rest are not saved.

steps.title: Use it as your recipe's lead picture
steps.help: Put your favourite at the top of the recipe.

nextSuggestions.why: Write posts to go with your pictures.
Describe and tag them so you can find them again.

planning.day-and-week@1.description: Jot down what needs doing, pick what to do today, and lay out the rest of the week.
planning.day-and-week@1.expectedOutcome: A short list for today and a plan for the week, kept apart from your content board.
planning.day-and-week@1.unavailableReason: Your day and week planner isn't built yet.

steps.title: Jot down what needs doing
steps.help: One line each. Details can wait.

steps.title: Pick what to do today
steps.help: Choose a few things for today. Anything else stays on your list.

steps.title: Lay out your week
steps.help: Spread the rest across the days ahead.

publishing.plan-and-publish@1.description: Choose something from your board, pick when it goes out in your own time zone, and confirm it.
publishing.plan-and-publish@1.expectedOutcome: A post booked for the time you chose in your own time zone, and a clear answer on whether it went through.

steps.title: Choose what to publish
steps.help: Pick a card from your board.

steps.title: Check it's ready
steps.help: Read the words and look at the picture one last time.

steps.title: Pick a time and schedule it
steps.help: Times are in your workspace's time zone. You confirm before anything is sent, and an Editor makes the booking.

steps.title: Check it went through
steps.help: See whether the booking was taken. If we couldn't tell, we say so and tell you what to do next.

nextSuggestions.why: Write the next batch of posts.

recipe.create@1.description: Write a recipe yourself or start from a first draft, then fill in what a recipe needs before you test it.
recipe.create@1.expectedOutcome: A recipe in your library with its ingredients, method, yield and time filled in, ready to test.

steps.title: Start your recipe
steps.help: Write it yourself, or get a first draft to change however you like. Nothing becomes your recipe until you keep it.

steps.title: Check your ingredients
steps.help: List everything that goes in, in your own words. We keep exactly what you write.

steps.title: Check your method
steps.help: Write the steps in the order you cook them, so someone else could follow along.

steps.title: What it makes and how long it takes
steps.help: Say how much it makes or how many it serves, and how long it takes, so readers can plan.

steps.title: Try it at another size
steps.help: See the amounts for a bigger or smaller batch. Nothing changes in your recipe unless you choose to keep it.

nextSuggestions.why: Cook it, note what happened, and approve it when it is right.
Turn it into a blog post people can find.
Make pictures of the finished dish.

recipe.improve@1.description: Change a recipe you already have, yourself or with suggestions you approve one by one.
recipe.improve@1.expectedOutcome: Your recipe with the changes you chose, saved as a new version, and the earlier one kept.

steps.title: Choose the recipe
steps.help: Pick the recipe from your library.

steps.title: Make your changes
steps.help: Ask for suggestions or change it yourself. Nothing changes until you say yes, and your own words stay as you wrote them.

steps.title: Decide on every suggestion
steps.help: Say yes or no to anything still waiting, and read any safety note before you go on.

steps.title: Compare with before
steps.help: See exactly what changed. Every earlier version is kept, so you can go back.

steps.title: Try it at another size
steps.help: See the amounts for a bigger or smaller batch. Nothing changes in your recipe unless you choose to keep it.

nextSuggestions.why: Cook the new version and approve it when it is right.

recipe.test-and-approve@1.description: Cook it, write down what happened, fix what went wrong, and give it the final yes.
recipe.test-and-approve@1.expectedOutcome: A recipe you have cooked, fixed and approved, with your test notes kept.

steps.title: Choose the recipe
steps.help: Pick the recipe from your library.

steps.title: Fill in the basics
steps.help: A recipe needs its ingredients, method, yield and time before it can be tested.

steps.title: Cook it and note what happened
steps.help: Make it from the recipe as written, then say how it turned out and anything that went wrong.

steps.title: Sort out what went wrong
steps.help: Fix the recipe or close each problem you noted. If a test failed, cook it again once it is fixed.

steps.title: Send it for review
steps.help: Say it is ready, and see anything still in the way first.

steps.title: Approve it
steps.help: Someone with Editor access gives it the final yes. Approving keeps this exact version.

nextSuggestions.why: Share the finished recipe in a blog post.
Make pictures of the finished dish.
Tell your followers it is ready.

social.create@1.description: Write a post for each of your channels about one recipe or idea, and choose the ones you like.
social.create@1.expectedOutcome: Posts you approved for each channel, with a picture, ready for your board.

steps.title: Choose what it's about
steps.help: A recipe or an idea. Your brand's voice and channels are used unless you change them.

steps.title: Write and choose your posts
steps.help: Each channel gets its own post, kept within its length. Edit any of them, then keep the ones you like.

steps.title: Pick a picture to go with them
steps.help: Choose one from your library.

steps.title: Add it to your content board
steps.help: Put it on your board so you can plan when it goes out. Nothing is posted yet.

nextSuggestions.why: Pick a time and schedule your posts.
